info.name: BaDCaT
info.description: BaDCaT WiFi modem cartridge: TL16C550C UART at I/O ports 0x80-0x87 (1.8432 MHz) with FIFOs, interrupts on /INT and auto flow control (MCR bit 5, FIFO mode). Only the external RS-232 port is emulated (wifi switch OFF); the ESP8266 WiFi modem is not. No ROM: software drives the UART directly. Connector: badcat-rs232. Setting badcat_rx_backpressure (default true) holds back incoming bytes while the RX FIFO is full; false overruns like real hardware.
